description: Unit tests for the MultiStageCommand component in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement package. The tests involve verifying command retrieval, modification, creation, and error handling scenarios that involve interactions with things and policies within the Ditto framework. The file uses JUnit and Akka testkit for actor-based asynchronous testing.

classes.name: MultiStageCommandTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing multi-stage command execution involving things and policies. Contains setup and teardown methods, as well as multiple test cases covering retrieval, modification, creation, timeout, and error scenarios.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem and mock actors before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: retrieveThingAndPolicy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a thing and its inline policy, verifying proper assembly and responses.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithoutPolicyWhenPermissionIsMissing
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the policy exists but permission for the default subject is missing.

methods.name: retrieveThingErrorIfCacheIsOutOfDate
methods.description: Tests error handling when cached data is out of date.

methods.name: retrieveThingErrorOnTimeout
methods.description: Tests the handling of timeout scenarios during retrieval.

methods.name: modifyExistingThing
methods.description: Verifies modification of an existing thing and propagation of success responses.

methods.name: createThingWithExistingPolicy
methods.description: Tests creation process when the thing does not exist but its policy exists.

methods.name: createThingAndPolicy
methods.description: Verifies creation when both thing and policy do not exist.

methods.name: createThingWithPolicyConflict
methods.description: Tests handling of policy conflict during creation.

methods.name: createThingWithExplicitPolicy
methods.description: Tests creation with an explicitly specified policy.

methods.name: createThingWithExplicitPolicyNotAuthorizedBySelf
methods.description: Verifies error when inline policy modifications are not permitted.

methods.name: newEnforcerActor
methods.description: Creates a test actor for performing enforcement logic.

methods.name: newMockEntitiesActor
methods.description: Creates a mock actor simulating entity responses.

methods.name: emptyThing
methods.description: Utility to create a placeholder thing with specified ID and policy.

methods.name: defaultPolicy
methods.description: Displays a default policy with read/write permissions for specific subjects.

methods.name: thingOnlyPolicy
methods.description: A policy that only grants permissions to a non-default subject.
